newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean foreign shipbuilding orders fall in 1996.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean foreign shipbuilding orders fall in 1996.

text.p: Foreign shipbuilding orders received last year by South Korean companies totalled 6.93 million gross tonnes, down from 7.13 million in 1995, the Korea Shipbuilders Association said on Wednesday.
Ships built during 1996 for foreign companies totalled 7.74 million gross tonnes, compared with 5.65 million gross tonnes built in 1995, the association said in a statement.
The statement said South Korean shipbuilders had outstanding foreign orders for 13.13 million gross tonnes at the end of 1996, down from 13.83 million a year earlier.
